description: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of factual errors across four different question-answering systems: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, Musique, and IIRC. The vertical axis represents the number of factual errors, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40. Each system is represented by a set of three bars, each corresponding to a different quality assurance (QA) method: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The bars are color-coded, with NoR QA in yellow, OneR QA in red, and IRCoT QA in blue. The values for factual errors are as follows: HotpotQA has 15 errors for NoR QA, 10 for OneR QA, and 5 for IRCoT QA; 2WikiMQA has 29 errors for NoR QA, 23 for OneR QA, and 14 for IRCoT QA; Musique has 28 errors for NoR QA, 27 for OneR QA, and 23 for IRCoT QA; IIRC has 15 errors for NoR QA, 14 for OneR QA, and 11 for IRCoT QA. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized.
